rules.title: Gateway authentication disabled
rules.rationale: The observed gateway control differs from the approved baseline. Exposure and unauthorized commands require separate network evidence; neither is established by this setting alone.

rules.title: Gateway authentication setting changed or missing
rules.rationale: The expected authentication-control value is changed or unavailable in the observed configuration. Verify visibility and device behavior before interpreting the risk.

rules.title: Remote access enabled
rules.rationale: Remote access is enabled contrary to the approved baseline. Confirm reachability, access controls, and change authorization.

rules.title: Firmware version changed
rules.rationale: Verify the installed image, vendor release, compatibility, and approved maintenance record.
